page.layout: One title page, all lines centred in one column. No notes in the margins. Greek motto at the top, then the title, a scripture reference with its quotation, a line of motto, a horizontal rule, and the imprint at the foot.
page.notes: The handwritten "2" at the top right is a manuscript mark and is not transcribed. The Greek motto's accents are hard to read at this resolution, so the whole line is marked [?]. The "Bibliopolæ" ending is partly obscured by a stain. The horizontal rule between the motto and the imprint is not text.
